description: The home of the hummingbird, Yerettê, is situated in Maracas, St. Joseph, and is a stunning location to observe several hummingbird species found in Trinidad and Tobago. The intimate setting and experience offered by Yerettê allow you an up-close look at these hummingbirds. Listed opening hours: Tour Times: 8am/ 11:30am/ 3 pm Tours are appointments Only!. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
